outcome: Length of stay after facility delivery
cohort: Women who gave birth in health facilities in 92 low- and middle-income countries
finding: Length of stay after childbirth varies widely across countries, with a substantial proportion of women staying too short to receive adequate postnatal care; factors associated with length of stay include mode of delivery, birthweight, multiple birth, infant survival status, maternal age, delivery attendant, and socioeconomic status.
mod_finding: Cesarean-section deliveries were associated with longer lengths of stay compared to vaginal deliveries.
